note: Hidalgo County NM has a county GIS (HC_Parcel, HC_Boundary layers on ArcGIS Online) but no public zoning district layer was found; HC_Parcel requires a token. The county commission handles zoning but no zoning ordinance or map is online. Lordsburg, the only sizeable city, publishes no zoning map or GIS layer on its website or ArcGIS Online.
